Summary: Complete UI/UX Overhaul
Description:
## Overview
Comprehensive UI/UX improvements to transform Ovo Focus into a polished, production-ready mobile experience.

## Objectives
- Improve visual hierarchy and design consistency
- Enhance accessibility for all users
- Optimize performance and animations
- Create a premium, engaging user experience

## Scope
- Visual Design System refinement
- Home Screen improvements
- Collection Screen overhaul
- Settings Screen improvements
- Animation and transition polish
- Accessibility improvements
- Performance optimization
- Advanced UX features

## Success Criteria
- Maintain 60fps during all animations
- Pass WCAG AA accessibility audit
- Positive user feedback on visual improvements
- Improved session completion rate

Summary: Implement responsive typography system with scaling
Description:
## Context
Timer font (72px) can overflow on smaller screens, rarity badges use 8px text that's hard to read, and font weights are inconsistent.

## Requirements
- Implement responsive typography scaling based on screen size
- Increase minimum readable text size to 10px
- Create explicit typography scale: display, headline, title, body, caption, micro
- Add letter-spacing adjustments for improved readability

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Typography scales smoothly on screens 320px-428px wide
- [ ] All text passes WCAG AA contrast requirements
- [ ] Timer remains readable without overflow on all supported devices

Summary: Add semantic color tokens and enhance color system
Description:
## Context
Limited color palette for UI states, no semantic color tokens for success/warning/error/info.

## Requirements
- Add semantic color tokens: success (#4CAF50), warning (#FF9800), error (#F44336), info (#2196F3)
- Create color variations: light, default, dark for each primary color
- Improve rarity color contrast for accessibility
- Add surface elevation colors (surface1, surface2, surface3)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Semantic colors defined and exported from theme.ts
- [ ] All rarity colors pass 4.5:1 contrast ratio
- [ ] Surface elevation creates clear visual hierarchy

Summary: Audit and fix spacing consistency across all components
Description:
## Context
Some components have inconsistent padding, screen margins vary, and touch targets are occasionally below 44px minimum.

## Requirements
- Audit all components for spacing consistency
- Implement 8px grid system strictly
- Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets
- Standardize screen padding (16px horizontal, 24px vertical)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All touch targets >= 44x44px
- [ ] Consistent 8px grid alignment
- [ ] Screen padding standardized across all views

Summary: Redesign home screen header with clear visual hierarchy
Description:
## Context
Three competing elements in header: collection link, streak badge, daily ring + settings. No clear visual hierarchy and elements feel cramped.

## Requirements
- Redesign header with clear primary/secondary grouping
- Move streak badge to more prominent position or integrate with stats
- Simplify daily progress indicator
- Add subtle separator or background treatment

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Clear visual hierarchy with one primary focal point
- [ ] Header elements have appropriate spacing
- [ ] Touch targets adequate for all header buttons

Summary: Enhance timer display with progress ring and visual feedback
Description:
## Context
Plain text timer display could be more engaging, no visual progress indication beyond text, pause state not visually distinct.

## Requirements
- Add circular progress ring around timer
- Implement color transitions as session progresses
- Create distinct visual treatment for paused state
- Add subtle glow effect that intensifies with progress

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Progress ring accurately reflects session progress
- [ ] Paused state is immediately recognizable
- [ ] Smooth color transitions without jank

Summary: Redesign session controls with improved button hierarchy
Description:
## Context
Controls at bottom could be more prominent, give up button placement could lead to accidental taps, pause count indicator is subtle.

## Requirements
- Create floating action bar with clear button hierarchy
- Add safe distance between destructive and constructive actions
- Make pause count indicator more prominent
- Add micro-animations on button state changes

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Primary action is most prominent
- [ ] Destructive actions require deliberate interaction
- [ ] Pause count clearly visible at all times

Summary: Add screen transition animations for modals
Description:
## Context
Modals appear instantly without animation, screen changes feel abrupt.

## Requirements
- Add slide-up animation for modals
- Implement crossfade for screen content changes
- Create state transition animations
- Animations complete within 300ms

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All modals have entrance/exit animations
- [ ] State changes feel smooth and intentional
- [ ] No animation jank or dropped frames

Summary: Implement screen reader support and accessibility labels
Description:
## Context
Accessibility labels may be incomplete, focus order might not be logical, announcements for state changes missing.

## Requirements
- Audit all components for accessibilityLabel
- Implement logical focus order
- Add announcements for session state changes
- Test with VoiceOver and TalkBack

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] App fully navigable with screen reader
- [ ] State changes announced appropriately
- [ ] All interactive elements have descriptive labels

Summary: Unify filter and sort UI with consistent styling
Description:
## Context
Filter chips have inconsistent styling, sort options not immediately discoverable, no visual indication of active filters.

## Requirements
- Unify chip styling: all outlined, filled when active
- Add filter badge showing count of active filters
- Add Clear all filters quick action
- Persist filter preferences across sessions

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Consistent chip styling throughout
- [ ] Active filter state clearly indicated
- [ ] Filters persist between app sessions

Summary: Optimize collection grid with virtualization and collapsible sections
Description:
## Context
No virtualization for large collections, staggered animations can feel slow with many items, rarity sections cannot collapse.

## Requirements
- Implement FlashList for virtualized rendering
- Add collapsible rarity sections
- Reduce animation stagger for large collections
- Add scroll to top button

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Smooth 60fps scrolling with 100+ animals
- [ ] Rarity sections collapsible
- [ ] Quick navigation for large collections

Summary: Redesign animal cards with enhanced visuals and clear progression
Description:
## Context
Emoji-only design may feel basic, level dots are subtle, count badges crowd the card.

## Requirements
- Enhance emoji with backgrounds or custom illustrations
- Redesign level indicator as progress bar or stars
- Add rarity-colored card borders
- Implement card flip animation for reveal

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Cards feel premium and polished
- [ ] Level progression clearly visible
- [ ] Rarity immediately identifiable

Summary: Create illustrated empty and error states
Description:
## Context
Empty state uses only emoji + text, no error state designs, loading state not implemented.

## Requirements
- Create illustrated empty states for each filter
- Design error state with retry action
- Add skeleton loading screens
- Add celebration state when collection complete

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every state has thoughtful design
- [ ] Error states provide recovery path
- [ ] Loading feels fast with skeletons

Summary: Improve egg interaction feedback and gesture discovery
Description:
## Context
Gesture hints only shown once, feedback messages could be more engaging.

## Requirements
- Add persistent subtle hint for interactions
- Create 10+ encouragement message variations
- Implement haptic patterns for message types
- Add visual feedback ripple on interaction

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users discover all gesture types naturally
- [ ] 10+ unique encouragement messages
- [ ] Haptic feedback matches interaction type

Summary: Redesign stats bar with compact pills and trends
Description:
## Context
Stats feel disconnected, BEST badge could be more celebratory, limited information density.

## Requirements
- Create compact stat pills with icons
- Add mini-trends for streak changes
- Animate BEST badge when achieved
- Add expandable stats view on tap

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Stats immediately comprehensible
- [ ] BEST achievement feels rewarding
- [ ] Tapping stats reveals detailed view

Summary: Refine micro-interactions and button feedback
Description:
## Context
Some buttons lack press feedback, toggle animations could be snappier.

## Requirements
- Audit all interactive elements for feedback
- Add satisfying toggle animations with overshoot
- Create success checkmark animation
- Implement button ripple effects

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Every interaction has immediate feedback
- [ ] Success/failure clearly communicated
- [ ] Ripple effect on button press

Summary: Implement loading and progress state indicators
Description:
## Context
No loading indicators during data operations, app feels frozen during heavy operations.

## Requirements
- Add loading spinner for async operations
- Implement optimistic UI updates
- Add skeleton screens for initial load
- Create progress indicators for long operations

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Users always know app is working
- [ ] Operations feel fast with optimistic updates
- [ ] Initial load uses skeleton screens

Summary: Audit and fix color contrast for WCAG AA compliance
Description:
## Context
Some text may not meet contrast requirements, no high contrast mode.

## Requirements
- Audit all text for WCAG AA compliance (4.5:1)
- Add patterns or icons alongside color coding
- Implement optional high contrast theme
- Test with color blindness simulators

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All text passes WCAG AA
- [ ] Information not conveyed by color alone
- [ ] High contrast option available

Summary: Enhance animal detail modal with animations and history
Description:
## Context
Modal appears without transition, limited information displayed, favorite toggle could be more prominent.

## Requirements
- Add slide-up entrance animation
- Display collection history
- Make favorite button prominent with animation
- Add share functionality

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Modal has smooth entrance/exit animations
- [ ] All relevant animal data displayed
- [ ] Share generates shareable image

Summary: Reorganize settings screen with icons and sections
Description:
## Context
Sections could be better grouped, focus duration buttons dont adapt to screen width.

## Requirements
- Reorganize into clear categories
- Use segmented control or slider for focus duration
- Add icons to each setting
- Create visual stats cards

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Settings logically grouped
- [ ] All controls adapt to screen width
- [ ] Icons aid quick comprehension

Summary: Optimize animation performance and battery usage
Description:
## Context
Multiple simultaneous animations on egg, infinite animations drain battery.

## Requirements
- Implement animation budgeting
- Pause animations when app backgrounded
- Clean up particles immediately after fade
- Use native driver for all animations

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Consistent 60fps during animations
- [ ] Battery usage reduced when idle
- [ ] No memory leaks from animations

Summary: Create guided onboarding flow for new users
Description:
## Context
No guided onboarding, gesture hints only shown once.

## Requirements
- Create 3-5 screen onboarding carousel
- Implement progressive disclosure
- Add tips system for advanced features
- Show whats new after updates

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New users complete onboarding in < 1 minute
- [ ] Core features understood before first session
- [ ] Tips appear contextually

Summary: Implement reduced motion support
Description:
## Context
No reduced motion support, animations might trigger vestibular issues.

## Requirements
- Detect and respect reduce motion setting
- Provide fallback static states
- Allow disabling particle effects

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Respects system reduce motion preference
- [ ] Alternative static designs work well
- [ ] User can disable specific animations

Summary: Optimize render performance with memoization
Description:
## Context
Collection may re-render unnecessarily, no memoization audit.

## Requirements
- Implement React.memo for pure components
- Add useMemo/useCallback where appropriate
- Implement lazy loading for modals
- Profile renders with React DevTools

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Reduced re-renders on state changes
- [ ] Modals load on-demand
- [ ] Measurable performance improvement

Summary: Redesign danger zone with proper confirmation flow
Description:
## Context
Delete button doesnt feel appropriately serious.

## Requirements
- Add visual warning treatment
- Implement two-step deletion
- Show what will be lost before deletion
- Add export data option

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Deletion feels appropriately serious
- [ ] Users understand consequences
- [ ] Export option available before delete

Summary: Add milestone celebrations and achievement system
Description:
## Context
Limited positive reinforcement, no milestone celebrations.

## Requirements
- Add milestone celebrations (10, 50, 100 sessions)
- Create achievement unlocked animations
- Implement streak milestones
- Create share cards for achievements

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Milestones trigger celebratory UI
- [ ] Users feel recognized for progress
- [ ] Shareable achievement cards
